text: これ　たのまれてるんだけど　わたして　くれるかい！

structure.jp: たのまれてるんだけど
わたして　くれるかい！
structure.en: would you hand it over for me?

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: わたして　くれるかい
patterns.explanation: て-form plus くれる means someone does something for you. かい is a casual question ending used by men. わたして　くれるかい = 'will you hand it over for me?'

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending says the subject received the action. たのまれてる = 'I have been asked'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ gives background, and けど softly leads into the request. たのまれてるんだけど = 'I was asked, and so...'
